description: E001 has an exact reported date and state-directed pension demands, but LGDC calls it a press conference and gives neither venue nor attendance. It is unclear whether it was a protest action or a small press briefing; threshold >=50 is not supported.
required_followup: Seek a distinct contemporaneous source or direct report giving venue, public/action character and simultaneous attendance; otherwise retain pending_evidence.

type: retiree protest series / date and continuity
description: Comores Infos reports a series of retiree demonstrations and government demands (S001) without event dates, locations, turnout or number of actions. LGDC says the collective voiced concerns since 14 October 2022 (S003), while a March 15 issue says negotiations began 7 August 2022 (S004). These may describe different campaign phases; no specific February qualifying demonstration is established.
required_followup: Find date/site/count for any specific February gathering and distinguish it from the older campaign and press conference; check March continuation without duplicating an ongoing action.

description: Comores Infos February archive page reports Ayman Nourdine’s death after gendarme arrest/violence on 27–28 February (S006). A search-only March 3 Habariza result says residents demonstrated in Vouvouni on 3 March after youth protested the previous day (S007). The available February page does not report a protest gathering.
required_followup: Investigate the March 2–3 demonstrations in the March dossier using fresh exact-URL assessment before any body request; do not backdate them into February.

description: Captured searches cover French and English general discovery and all four weekly windows, local Comorian outlets, Moroni/Grande Comore, Anjouan and Mohéli leads, retirement, market, university/education, health, transport, politics, prices and public-service issues. Search results are highly date-noisy and often return France, Morocco, older Comorian stories or unrelated material. Arabic and Swahili-oriented queries yielded mostly non-Comorian results; no Shikomori-native query was captured.
required_followup: If feasible, consult Shikomori-language/local-island sources and the broader LGDC/Comores Infos archives; preserve this bounded web-search scope and make no absence/exhaustiveness claim.

description: Research used open-web search and captured local news pages; it did not reproduce the codebook’s Lexis-Nexis newspaper search or systematically examine all local print/radio archives. One Comores Infos archive page covered only page 1 of 14.
required_followup: Continue only with feasible targeted source/archive searches for specific unresolved claims; report unavailable archives as a method limitation, not evidence of no protests.
